title: Voice and Video Calls Built Right Into the App | vitalii.no
description:
A call that rings inside the app, survives a 30-second network blip, and never loses its history.

Parents and kids could message inside bir, but an actual conversation meant leaving the app for a separate caller — breaking the single safe-space promise bir was built on, and losing the call history entirely.

A new WebRTC layer now handles the whole call lifecycle: a client-side state machine drives ringing, answering and hangup, while a dedicated server route handles signaling and logging. Short-lived TURN credentials let calls relay through a coturn server when a direct peer connection fails, and every call is written to a new calls table with its full status history, linked back to the original conversation.

Calls now ring for up to 45 seconds via push before falling back to missed, and survive a 30-second network blip without dropping — with every status, from ringing to missed, declined, busy or ended, tracked end-to-end.
